# Start Heal Over Time

Source: [wiki article 4452](../archive/4452.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Heal Over Time](../../api/actions/start-heal-over-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4452-n1"></a>

- HoT persists until duration expiry or script stop and exposes Last Heal Over Time ID for cleanup.

<a id="wiki-4452-n2"></a>

- Null healer gives no credit; long duration such as 9999 is suggested for script-controlled expiry.
